messages:
lia: Kicking off planned router cutover for eu-west at 22:00 UTC. The plan is a gradual weight shift 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with 10m observation windows. @matt @eva FYI :wave:

matt: ack. I'll monitor latency and error rates on the console. Can we keep current model variant pinned for 2m extra if we see regressions?

eva: yes, keep model:v3-pinned on fallback route. If 5xx rate > 0.5% or p95 latency increases by >120ms we pause and revert to blue.

sre-bot: scheduled action created: router.cutover(eu-west) windows=["1769007600","1769011200"] owner=lia id=cb-ff42

lia: deploy-bot, start canary now please.

deploy-bot: canary deployment started: router-group eu-west, new-backend=green-v2, initial-weight=5%. Health checks passing (3/3).

jules: monitoring hooks: grafana: /d/latency/eu-west , logs: /logs/router/eu-west, uptime alert channel #eng-oncall. I'll post snapshots at each step.

matt: observed: 5% at +3m -> errors stable, p95 +10ms. proceeding to 25%.

deploy-bot: traffic update: weights -> green:25, blue:75. Timestamp 1769004583

eva: after 25% window: small spike in 502s on a single pod, drained and restarted green-3. error budget intact. advance to 50%? :thinking:

sre-bot: note: drained pod green-3 -> restarted under autorecover, readiness probe restored at 1769004705

lia: go to 50% but keep 2m pin on model variant. Watch key customers (cust-zen, cust-ora) traces.

matt: 50% -> p95 +35ms, errors back to baseline. advancing to 100% in 10m if stable.

deploy-bot: traffic update: weights -> green:50, blue:50. Timestamp 1769004789

jules: snapshot attached (link) — increased RPS by 8% but throughput healthy.

eva: rolling to 100%. rollback triggers restated: >0.8% 5xx or sustained p95 +200ms for 5m -> rollback.

lia: proceeding with final shift. deploy-bot, perform final change at +10m window.

deploy-bot: final shift scheduled at 1769005350, will increment to green:100 over 3s step with circuit-breaker configured.

matt: if anything odd ping @sre-oncall and run: `curl -I https://router.eu-west/health` and `kubectl get pods -l svc=router -o wide`

eva: all good — thanks team. postmortem doc template is prefilled in #postmortems if we hit rollback. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: completed: router.cutover(eu-west) status=success end_ts=1769004920 

lia: ✅ cutover complete. leaving brief notes in release notes draft. Thanks all :tada:
